name: How long does kitchen cabinet refacing take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen cabinet refacing take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen cabinet refacing typically ranges from 3 to 5 days, depending on the size of your kitchen and the complexity of the design. This timeframe is significantly shorter than a full cabinet replacement, which can take several weeks. Factors like the number of cabinets, the material chosen for the new doors and veneer, and any additional modifications, such as adding new hardware, can influence the project timeline. Our team will provide a detailed schedule upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen cabinet refacing usually takes 3 to 5 days, much quicker than a full replacement.
